text: Expose a schema-validated A2A Agent Card for the Aimparency Strategy Agent
description: When activation evidence exists, generate the official A2A 1.0 Agent Card for an Aimparency Strategy Agent. Advertise only focused skills and supported interfaces; do not disclose credentials, private graph state, prompts, or broad internal tool access. Pair it with an authenticated read-only explain-strategy-context skill, a fixture peer/conformance test, and an audit record of disclosed context. Do not implement before a qualified customer workflow or credible deploying peer agrees to a concrete interoperability test.

status.comment: Architecture is ready, but implementation is gated on real activation evidence: a customer workflow requiring independent specialist-agent coordination or a credible deployer agreeing to a dated concrete exchange.
